note: billet AI Bridge remboursé par remise de 8 421 146 actions au 15 mai 2024 ; avenants des 27 mars et 26 avril 2024
quote: that certain Unsecured Promissory Note, made by the Company on January 30, 2024 and amended on March 27, 2024 and April 26, 2024 (the "AI Note") in favor of AI Bridge Funding LLC (the "Holder"), was prepaid in its entirety through the issuance of an aggregate of 8,421,146 shares of Common Stock
